name: Editable
purpose: Present inline text editing with Atom-owned draft, commit, cancel and focus behavior.
useWhen: An existing text value should become an input or textarea on demand.

avoidWhen.condition: The field should always be editable.

composition: Use Root or RootProvider, Area, Preview and exactly one Input or Textarea. Provide Label or an accessible name, with optional Control and triggers.

rules.statement: Separate draft changes from commit requests; saving, errors and retries belong to the application.
Update controlled value and edit in their callbacks. Create an external controller inside the Field scope when it must inherit Field state.
Load styles.css or core.css plus editable.css and the styles of composed components.

commonMistakes.mistake: Rendering both Input and Textarea or saving every draft as a completed edit.
commonMistakes.correction: Use one named native editor and save on the explicit commit boundary.

validation: Verify empty and defaultEdit rollback, controlled refusal, keyboard, outside events and IME.
Verify Field/form reset, textarea autoresize, nested Dialog focus, preview/editor geometry, RTL, appearances and forced colors.
